title: 37-year-old shot dead by RCMP; was sought for sex assault and attempted murder
article: A 37-year-old man is dead after an officer-related shooting in Red Deer.
RCMP say there was a confrontation with a suspect who had collided with a number unoccupied vehicles with a stolen front-end loader, as well as an unoccupied police car.
Eventually, a chase ended in a field with the man being shot by RCMP.
The deceased had been sought in connection to a sexual assualt on a 47-year-old woman and the attempted murder of a 20-year-old man from the same incident Friday morning in the city.
Police add the victims knew the deceased, who is not being named at this time, as ASIRT has been called in to investigate.

Red Deer, AB � The Red Deer RCMP have been involved in a member related shooting at about 2:00 p.m., today where a confrontation with a suspect who had collided with a number of unoccupied vehicles with a stolen front-end loader in an industrial park in the northwest corner of the City of Red Deer, and also collided with an unoccupied police car shortly thereafter, has ended in a field near Range Road 273 and Township Road 391 with the discharge of an RCMP pistol and the 37 year old adult male suspect dead. The suspect had also previously collided with an occupied truck west of Red Deer near Burnt Lake, but there were no serious injuries. No police or other persons have been injured by this sequence of events.

The deceased had been sought by the RCMP in connection with a sexual assault upon a 47 year old female and the attempted murder upon a 20 year old male (from the same incident), that occurred early this morning in Red Deer. The deceased and the victims of the sexual assault and the attempted murder were known to each other. All persons were from the Red Deer area. The two victims� injuries are not life threatening and they have received medical attention.

The Director of Law Enforcement for Alberta Justice and Solicitor General Ministry has ordered that, in accordance with established protocols for serious incidents involving police, the Alberta Serious Incident Response Team (ASIRT) will take carriage of the investigation into the shooting of the deceased, while the RCMP will remain as the investigating agency for the earlier assault and attempted murder, collisions with vehicles and theft of the front-end loader.
No further information will be provided or responded to regarding the police shooting and the media may contact ASIRT media relations for updates in that matter.

A media release will be issued at a later time with the results of the RCMP investigation into the assaults, ramming of cars and theft of the front-end loader. No additional information is available at this time in those matters. The RCMP will not be releasing the name of the deceased in order to protect the privacy of the victims.
